description_en: Deletes a custom face, all the custom faces that are registered in a custom figure library, or a custom figure library
description_zh: 注销⼀张⾃定义⼈脸，或者注销某个⾃定义⼈物下的所有⼈脸
kebab_example: aliyun mts unregister-custom-face --category-id CategoryId001-0000 --person-id PersonId001-0000 --face-id 150000 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnregisterCustomFace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the figure library. The ID is used to uniquely identify a figure library. You can specify the ID of a custom figure library. Make sure that the ID is unique. If you set this parameter to the ID of a system figure library, the system figure library is used. The ID can be up to 120 characters in length and is not case-sensitive. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html operation to query the figure library ID
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物库ID。⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库，由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性。
<notice>不能与系统⼈物库ID相同 ，如相同则默认使用系统人物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html接口查询。></notice>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the figure. The ID is used to uniquely identify a custom figure. Make sure that the ID is unique. The ID can be up to 120 characters in length and is not case-sensitive. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html operation to query the figure ID. If you set this parameter to ALL, all the faces in the specified figure library are deleted, and the custom figure library is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物ID。用于唯一标识一个自定义人物。由调用者自己保证唯一性。

最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html接口查询。如果填“ALL”，表示注销该CategoryId下所有⼈脸，同时删除该人物库
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the face. The ID is used to uniquely identify a face. Make sure that the ID is unique. The ID can be up to 120 characters in length and is not case-sensitive. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html operation to query the face ID. If you set this parameter to ALL, all the faces associated with the specified figure are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
人脸ID。用于唯一标识一张人脸，由调用者自己保证唯一性。

最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html接口查询。如果填“ALL”，表示注销该PersonId下所有⼈脸
parameters.name: face_id
